requirements.requirement: There is a letter written in the first half of the twentieth century.
The letter was written from a ruler of one country to another party, who is the letter's recipient.
The letter was delivered by an official.
The official was nicknamed after a body part by the letter's recipient.
The letter was written roughly six months after the author of the letter, the ruler from whom it was written, had come to power.
In the letter, the author refers to the author's country having regained a region.
The region referred to is the region that the author's country had regained, as stated in the letter.
The name of the region referred to in the letter is the requested answer.
